summary.text: Stan May is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 80 since 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Stan May took office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Mike Ritze.
Ballotpedia lists his 2025-2026 committee assignment as the Government Oversight Committee.
Jeremy Founds, a Democrat, is his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
